title: Secret US Air Force plane landed without Brazilian authorization

tellings.quote: Because they landed without the authorization of the Brazilian government. It was a secret mission and it was a US Air Force plane.

plain: In 1996, a US Air Force plane is said to have landed in Varginha, a town in Brazil, on a secret mission, without the Brazilian government's permission. The documentary filmmaker James Fox relays this from someone who told him, in an episode about a Brazilian hospital said to have operated on an alien, as a sign that the US was quietly involved.
